name: Mistress Fane
note: Tollhaven's harbour mage (world doc v1.74 §3.7), who keeps the ward on the harbour chain, salt-written on its links and lettered again at every low water. By the square's well with a pot of wet salt and a brush. Tells every time by the tide (copy-review §8). Gives and takes in The Chain Ward (the drowned bosuns' whistles foul it) and Signal Powder (the Gull Fleet's, before it signals anything else).
